from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import cv2

def pose(g):
 T=np.eye(4);T[:3,3]=g[:3];T[:3,:3]=R.from_quat(g[3:]).as_matrix();return T

def transform(p,T):return p@T[:3,:3].T+T[:3,3]

def green(im):
 im=im.astype(float);return (im[:,:,1]>80)&(im[:,:,1]>im[:,:,0]*1.5+20)&(im[:,:,1]>im[:,:,2]*1.5+20)

def ghost_template():
 ps=[]
 for c in cams:
  mask=green(obs.last[c]);p=cloud(c)[mask];ps.append(p)
 ps=np.concatenate(ps)
 T=pose(obs.meta['task']['goal']);loc=transform(ps,np.linalg.inv(T))
 # Tool's long axis is local x; reject isolated green fingertips.
 print('ghost percentiles',np.percentile(loc,[0,5,50,95,100],axis=0))
 return loc

def scenes():
 ps=[];cs=[]
 for c in cams:
  im=obs.last[c];p=cloud(c)
  mask=(~green(im)) & (p[:,:,2]>.55)&(p[:,:,2]<.9)&(p[:,:,0]>-.3)&(p[:,:,0]<.4)&(p[:,:,1]>-.2)&(p[:,:,1]<.3)
  # gray tool, removing bright white robot surfaces and table
  mask &= (im.max(2)-im.min(2)<25)&(im.mean(2)<235)&(im.mean(2)>40)
  ps.append(p[mask]);cs.append(im[mask])
 return np.concatenate(ps),np.concatenate(cs)

def fit_tool(T0,template,iters=35,cut=.025):
 scene,col=scenes();tree=cKDTree(scene);T=T0.copy()
 for k in range(iters):
  p=transform(template,T);dist,idx=tree.query(p)
  good=dist<cut
  if good.sum()<30:print('too few matches',good.sum());break
  src=p[good];dst=scene[idx[good]]
  # Cauchy weights downweight interference and missing regions.
  wt=1/(1+(dist[good]/.008)**2)
  a=np.average(src,axis=0,weights=wt);b=np.average(dst,axis=0,weights=wt)
  U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(((src-a)*wt[:,None]).T@(dst-b))
  rr=Vt.T@U.T
  if np.linalg.det(rr)<0:Vt[-1]*=-1;rr=Vt.T@U.T
  tt=b-rr@a;delta=np.eye(4);delta[:3,:3]=rr;delta[:3,3]=tt
  T=delta@T
 print('fit',np.round(T[:3,3],4),'euler',np.round(R.from_matrix(T[:3,:3]).as_euler('xyz',degrees=True),2),'inlier',good.sum(),'rms',np.sqrt(np.mean(dist[good]**2)))
 return T

def overlay(T,template,name):
 pp=transform(template,T)
 for c in cams:
  cal=obs.meta['cameras'][c];cam=transform(pp,np.linalg.inv(np.array(cal['cam2world_gl'])));cam[:,1:]*=-1
  uv=cam@np.array(cal['intrinsic_cv']).T;uv=uv[:,:2]/uv[:,2:]
  im=obs.last[c].copy()
  for u,v in uv:
   if 0<=u<320 and 0<=v<240:im[int(v),int(u)]=[255,0,255]
  Image.fromarray(im).resize((960,720)).save('/app/output/'+name+'_'+c+'.png')
